Must purchase and complete online learning prior to scheduling skills eval. Please call to schedule the skills evaluation after completion of the online course. You will have to bring proof of online course completion to your skills eval. LINK FOR ONLINE PORTION OFFERED COURSES Stand Alone Courses Click on photo to learn more BLS Certification Course - Initial or Renewal $85 June 6th 2026 Initial and renewal BLS training for healthcare providers who need hands-on CPR, AED, ventilation, and team-resuscitation practice with an in-person skills evaluation. 8-Hour Infection Control Course $395 June 6th 2026 California Dental Board-aligned infection control training covering required precautions, clinical safety habits, and compliance expectations for dental students and professionals. Radiation Safety Course $695 June 6th 2026 Board-aligned radiography training covering x-ray safety, digital imaging, manikin practice, written testing, and supervised clinical patient requirements. Stand Alone Courses Click on photo to learn more Coronal Polish Course $500 June 20th 2026 Hands-on coronal polishing instruction with didactic, laboratory, manikin, and clinical patient requirements for eligible dental assistants. Pit and Fissure Sealant Course $550 June 20th 2026 Sealant certification training for qualified dental assistants and RDAs, including manikin practice, written testing, and supervised clinical patient requirements. OFFERED COURSES Dental Assisting Training Course -$2500.00 Our dental assisting program is designed to be completed in just 9 weeks. The program prepares students for an entry-level position in a dental office. All lectures and hands on learning will be done in our office at Waikiki Dental. We keep class sizes small for a better teacher to student focus. Our goal is to set students up for success by teaching you exactly what the staff at the dental office will expect you to know. Our accelerated program totals 9 weeks (210 hours) of combined class, clinical, and homework. Classes generally meet on either Mondays or Friday with one day of assigned externship. Students move through a focused 210-hour schedule with class, clinical practice, homework, and an assigned externship day that connects classroom skills to real office workflow. Next course starts: Friday, June 19th 2026 LEARN MORE N95 Fit Test - $89.99 (By Appointment Only) Qualitative test for N-95 Masks. This will help bring you in compliance with OSHA regulations. We can perform the initial fit test as well as the annual fit test. We will use the TSI Portacount machine to fit test one N95 mask, Each additional mask is $20. You must provide the mask you wish to be test on. Due to the way the test is done the mask will not be able to be used after the test is complete. A report will be generated and emailed to you detailing the results of the fit test. For best results please do not have facial hair or wear makeup. BOOK APPOINTMENT HERE One-on-one Implant and Bone Grafting Coaching Learn to place dental implant using both CBCT guided as well as free hand techniques. Bone grafting and crestal approach sinus augmentation using various techniques including PRF. This is a custom tailored course, directly with Dr. Michael Narodovich, hands on with your own patients. This is ideal for dentists who have taken courses but do not feel comfortable grafting and placing implant on their own. This course is 100% customizable to your needs and learning style. BOOK APPOINTMENT HERE COURSES FOR HYGIENIST ERGONOMICS AND PATIENT CARE A skills-based refresher for dental hygienists covering periodontal review, clinical ergonomics, and scaling techniques—now expanded to include dental emergencies, common medications and their implications for periodontal health, patient communication, and referral decision-making. Participants will reinforce periodontal fundamentals and risk assessment, improve operator/patient positioning to reduce musculoskeletal strain, and refine instrumentation. WHY DENTAL ASSISTING? Employment Outlook Dental Assistants jobs are expected to increase by 15.3% between 2018 and 2028. Median Wage Starting pay is between $18 - $22 depending on your state and employer. Flexible Schedules Dental assisting gives you an opportunity to have a work/life balance. Full time, part time, and temping positions allows for a flexible work schedule. Not to mention most offices have evenings, weekends, and holidays off. Multiple Career Paths Being a Dental Assistant is the stepping stone into the dental field. You will explore a variety of career options the dental field has to offer. As a dental assistant you will have the knowledge to make an easy transition to another role in dentistry. Dental Board Course Details Student questions often start with approval status, requirements, and what to bring. These details keep the next step clear before anyone enrolls. Approved course lists The Dental Board of California advises applicants to verify programs and courses through the official approved-provider lists before enrolling. View Dental Board lists Roseville course approvals Current public Dental Board lists show Roseville Dental Academy for Radiation Safety X1036, Infection Control IC189, Coronal Polishing CP148, and Pit and Fissure Sealants PF186. Verify provider numbers Patient requirements Clinical courses may require students to bring eligible patients. The academy team confirms the exact patient count, screening rules, and paperwork before registration.
